name: MP3 player DFPlayer Mini (microSD, 3 W amp)
description: Plays MP3 clips from a microSD card through a small speaker: the way to make a device talk. The board sends it 10-byte serial commands at 9600 baud. In Faber the clips are text (the "clips" prop: one "N: words" line per track) and playing track N says those words. Wiring: VCC → 5V / VBUS, GND → GND, RX ← board TX through 1 kΩ, TX → board RX, SPK_1 / SPK_2 → speaker + / -.

pins.label: VCC
pins.description: Supply 3.2 to 5 V. 5 V (VBUS) gives full volume; 3.3 V works but quieter. Draws about 20 mA idle and up to 200 mA on loud clips.

pins.label: RX
pins.description: Serial into the module, 9600 baud 8N1. From the board's TX pin through a 1 kΩ resistor (cuts the hiss and protects the 3.3 V input). Uno/Nano: a SoftwareSerial TX pin such as D11; XIAO RP2040: D6 (Serial1 TX, GP0).

pins.label: TX
pins.description: Serial out of the module (3.3 V logic): online / ACK / track finished replies. To the board's RX pin (Uno/Nano: the SoftwareSerial RX pin such as D10; XIAO RP2040: D7 = Serial1 RX, GP1). Optional if the sketch never reads replies.

pins.label: DAC_R
pins.description: Right line-level output (about 0.7 V RMS) for an external amplifier or headphones. Leave unwired when a speaker is on SPK_1 / SPK_2.

pins.label: SPK_1
pins.description: Speaker output + of the built-in 3 W amplifier (bridged). To the speaker's + lead. Never connect it to GND.

pins.label: SPK_2
pins.description: Speaker output - (bridged, not ground). To the speaker's - lead.

pins.label: BUSY
pins.description: Status output: LOW while a clip plays, HIGH (3.3 V) when idle. Wire it to a free board pin and digitalRead it to know when it finished talking (or wait for the 0x3D reply).

pins.label: USB-
pins.description: USB data - (the module can appear as a USB card reader). Not used in Faber.

pins.label: USB+
pins.description: USB data +. Not used in Faber.

pins.label: ADKEY2
pins.description: Resistor-ladder key input 2 (plays tracks 6 to 15 by resistor value). Not emulated.

pins.label: ADKEY1
pins.description: Resistor-ladder key input 1 (tracks 1 to 5, play / pause, volume). Not emulated.

pins.label: IO2
pins.description: Button to GND: short press = next track, long press = volume up. Not emulated (send commands over RX).

pins.label: IO1
pins.description: Button to GND: short press = previous track, long press = volume down. Not emulated.

props.label: What it says (track: words)
props.description: The words of each clip on the card, one "N: words" line per track ("2/5: words" for folder 02, file 005). Playing track N says them: speech bubble, the browser's voice, read_speech and the {"said": …} test step. export_manufacturing writes them to sd-card/ with a script that turns them into MP3s. JSON {"1": "hi!"} is accepted too.

props.label: microSD card inserted
props.description: Without a card the module answers its error frame at power-up and plays nothing.

footprint: 20 x 20 mm module, 2 x 8 pin 0.1 in header, rows 0.7 in apart

bindings.description: 3.0 to 5.5 V on VCC.
